sample_from_distribution: sample n events from a Distrax Distribution using a PRNG key and sample_shape
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of an event given a Distrax Distribution instance
calculate_kl_divergence: calculate the KL divergence between two Distrax or TFP distributions
get_batch_shape: get the batch shape tuple of a Distrax Distribution by evaluating its sample spec
index_distribution_batch: index a Distrax Distribution batch shape using to_batch_shape_index utility function
